snippet.title: Vertex Trailer 2
snippet.description:
Reach the peak of your freedom.

Welcome to Vertex, the unique 3D platformer adventure with creative sandbox elements from Dyro Studio. Step into the role of a brave little robot and embark on a journey high above the clouds! In a colorful world made up of floating islands, mysterious blocks, and tricky parkour challenges, your skill and creativity are put to the test.

Build your path, jump over dizzying chasms, and collect valuable treasures as you work your way up level by level.
